This update for yt-dlp fixes the following issues:

  * utils: float_or_none: Catch OverflowError

  * apple: Rework extractors
  * ard: Remove dead extractor
  * bandcamp: Support browser impersonation

  * tiktok: Fix formats extraction

  * twitter: broadcast: Fix events handling
  * vimeo: Remove ios and macos clients

  * youtube: Add visionos player client

  * youtube: Fix live adaptive fragments generation

  * youtube: tab: Always extract channel metadata

Update to version 2026.07.04:

  * The minimum recommended Python version has been raised to
    3.11

  * utils: parse_duration: Return int when appropriate

  * utils: pkcs1pad: Fix invalid PKCS#1 v1.5 padding bytes
  * utils: qualities: Avoid repeated index lookups
  * utils: random_user_agent: Bump version range 143-149 =>

  * tab: Fix metadata extraction

Vulnerabilities.Description: yt-dlp and youtube-dl are command-line audio/video downloaders. Prior to 2026.7.4, the --write-link, --write-url-link, and --write-desktop-link options can write .url or .desktop shortcut files using attacker-controlled webpage_url or filename metadata without sufficient validation or escaping, allowing malicious file:// URI injection on Windows or newline-based desktop entry key injection on Linux that can execute commands if the generated shortcut is opened. This issue is fixed in version 2026.7.4.
